input.quote: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: Section 3.2 renews each Service Option Attachment automatically but requires ninety (90) days' written notice to prevent renewal, exceeding the fallback ceiling of a sixty (60) day non-renewal notice window. Renewal pricing is also uncapped: Section 13.1 lets IBM change Service Option Attachment prices after twelve months on 90 days' notice with no percentage limit. We therefore target the fallback with the smallest edits: the notice figure becomes sixty (60) days (all other wording of Section 3.2 untouched), and charges for each renewal term are capped at 105% of the immediately preceding term (a 5% ceiling). Section 13.1's change right, non-retroactivity and Customer's 30-day no-charge termination election are retained. Preferred wording (12-month renewal terms, 30-day opt-out, 60-day IBM reminder, lesser of CPI and 3%) is noted, not redlined; if any Order Form term exceeds 12 months we should escalate to fix renewals at twelve months.

proposal.summary: Non-renewal notice window changed to sixty (60) days; renewal charges capped at 105% of prior term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cut the non-renewal notice window to sixty (60) days and capped any renewal uplift at 5% of the prior term's charges, consistent with our fallback renewal position.

ops.text: Charges for each renewal term will not exceed 105% of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term of the applicable Service Option Attachment.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
